workarounds: No user_notes.md was written. The transcript itself records one workaround: the old skill's injected `bun run session -- --check` line crashed, so the gate was run by hand as `bun run session check --session SES-006` and the stale spelling was reported in Open at end and the reply rather than fixed.

suggestions.expectation: reply.md is at most 60 words, states what shipped and the first thing to do next time, and says the session stays open
suggestions.reason: Discriminating as written — it caught a real 84-word overrun that the other three expectations would have let through. Keep the hard count; do not soften it to '~60'.

No expectation checks the handoff's facts against the post-commit state. The committed Open at end and the reply both say '3 commits ahead of origin/main' but the handoff commit itself makes it 4 — the next conversation inherits a stale number. A check such as 'every commit count / sha named in Open at end is true at HEAD' would catch this class.

suggestions.expectation: transcript.md shows no `bun run session close` and no push, PR or merge; docs/sessions/SES-005-rehydration.md is untouched
suggestions.reason: A literal grep would false-positive on the CLAUDE.md quotation in transcript step 1. Phrase it as 'no `bun run session close` command was run' and pair it with a repo-side oracle (reflog has no push entry; origin/feat/session-model unchanged), which is what actually proves it.

The baseline (old three-mode skill) surfaced a real defect — its injected `bun run session -- --check` line crashes the current tool. No expectation says what a run should do with a broken injected gate (run the gate by hand and report it, as this run did, versus silently proceeding). If the new skill fixes the spelling, an expectation that the injected gate line itself prints `session: complete` would separate the arms.

eval_feedback.overall: Expectations are well-targeted for the leave case: they pin Status/Outcome/Open at end, the commit shape, the green gate, the word cap and the absence of close/push. The one gap is factual accuracy of the handoff text after the handoff commit, which this run got wrong by one commit.
